title: hubahu jo shabihe ali hai, baaghe alam me paida hua hai
body:
hubahu jo shabihe ali hai, baaghe aalam me paida hua hai
mushkile dekh kar keh rahi hai, doosra ye to mushkil kusha hai
<<DIVIDER>>
apne qaime se tewar badal kar, aaye maida'n me abbas jis dam
bole marhab sifat lashkari sab, ye to haidar nazar aa raha hai
<<DIVIDER>>
pani chullu me lekar jo phainka, goya darya pe maara tamacha
reh gayi sar patak ti hi mouje, pyasa darya se wapas hua hai
<<DIVIDER>>
momino ke dilo hi se pucho, kisko kehte hai joshe masarrat
jashne abbas ki ab khushi hai, bazm me shor salle ala hai
<<DIVIDER>>
dusri padh ke naade ali ab, isko aawaaz dete hai momin
hoke bedast girte huwou ka, mushkilo me yahi aasra hai
<<DIVIDER>>
baandhna laazmi hai waha'n to, sabko ehraam haj e wafa ka
rouza abbas ka karbala me, ek kaaba wafa ka bana hai
<<DIVIDER>>
tumko ummul banee'n ho mubarak, isse badh kar bhi kya hogi nisbat
ye to farzand hai wo tumhara, jisko zahra ne beta kaha hai
